newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO mulls Y100 bln straight bond issue -- sources.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO mulls Y100 bln straight bond issue -- sources.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co (TEPCO) is considering issuing a domestic 10-year straight bond worth 100 billion yen, bond market sources said on Wednesday.
"TEPCO may choose a lead-manager on Wednesday," one source said. "There is a strong possibility that it may set the terms of the bond and start the subscription period on Thursday."
An official at the power company confirmed that it was asking prospective lead-managers for information concerning the issuance of a domestic straight bond.
